review: CAMLparam3 roots arguments; pending actions before descriptor extraction; copies scalar/native handles and length before no-pending runtime release. Released POSIX helper operates only on stack result/stat/descriptor scalars; reacquires before rooted result tuple/Int64/error-option allocation.

No descriptor acquisition or close in FD clone primitive. Source/destination exclusivity retained by caller/worker duplicate ownership. Preflight checks readable regular source, exact source length, distinct singly linked empty writable nonappend output and initial cursor.

On macOS FD backend returns explicit no-effect platform decline after preflight (empty input may return No_work); native APFS named clone API is separate. Snapshot fallback copies/hashes, verifies output and source stability. Not a native FD clone success claim.

Owner component namespace/publication APIs have explicit nonportable interface declarations. Representative compiler controls bind exact named rejections. No blanket exclusion of all componentHash functions: pure record encoding and borrowed-descriptor staging have separate contracts.
